findings.title: Focused Regression Denominator & Suite Selection Reconciled
findings.details: Phase 182 reported 216 passing tests across 12 phase suites (203 tests) plus 2 packaging/secret suites (13 tests). Phase 183 reported 215 passing tests across only the 13 phase-numbered suites (203 + 12 = 215 tests), omitting the 2 security/packaging suites from its command line. When all 15 suites are run across Phases 171-183 + packaging + secrets, 228 of 228 tests pass cleanly (100% PASS). No tests were dropped or silently altered.

findings.title: Dependency Pin Contract Omission Remediated (RP-184-01)
findings.details: tests/test_dependency_pin_contract.py inspects the highest-numbered PHASE*_RELEASE_GATES.json for a verification_environment block. In Phase 183, PHASE183_RELEASE_GATES.json omitted this block, causing 4 contract test failures. Resolved in Phase 184 by declaring verification_environment matching requirements.txt (Python 3.12.10, pytest 9.0.3, Windows-10, and all 7 pinned dependencies). All 4 tests now pass 100%.

findings.title: Legacy Simulator Test Fixture Directional Geometry Defects
findings.details: Two legacy tests fail due to invalid setup geometry: test_accounting_9q.py passes take_profit (100) <= entry (100) for a BULLISH setup, and test_stage4_paper_certification.py uses a lambda that sets stop_loss (150) < entry (160) for a BEARISH setup. In both cases, TradeSimulator hardened geometry validation correctly rejects the invalid setup. Production code must not be modified to accommodate invalid test geometries.

findings.title: Stop-Rounding Semantics & Risk Budget Distinctions Verified
findings.details: Verified that tick normalization under CONSERVATIVE policy rounds Long stops UP (CEILING) and Short stops DOWN (FLOOR), contracting gross distance and reducing nominal stop loss. Confirmed that Phase 182 Scenario 1 passed only because it explicitly requested FLOOR policy (expanding gross distance) and round-trip fees pushed total risk over the budget. Phase 183 tests rigorously distinguish raw gross loss, normalized gross loss, fees, total risk, and budget.

findings.title: Execution Boundary & Sentinel Isolation Certified
findings.details: Offline SpyExecutionAdapter confirms 0 live adapter calls across all candidate rejection paths, including risk budget breaches, friction hurdle failures, stale books, inverted books, constraint violations, and non-finite numeric inputs. assert_no_live_adapter_invocation() == 0 at all times.
